claude-sdk.title: Claude Agent SDK · Fixed execution
claude-sdk.fixed_boundary: This SDK model is fixed by administrator configuration. It does not use a platform gateway deployment or grant execution permission.
claude-sdk.usage_boundary: Usage is observed only and may be partial. Platform-enforced budgets and complete supplier billing are unavailable through this SDK path.
claude-sdk.invalid_evidence: The original SDK evidence does not match its configuration, session or execution state. Read the original run again before using these facts.
claude-sdk.unrecorded: No original SDK execution evidence is recorded. Configuration does not establish model access or execution success.
claude-sdk.denied_callbacks: Local callback denials, including cancelled questions
claude-sdk.delivery_boundary: Saving a decision, writing to the local SDK host and closing execution are separate facts. A local write is not a supplier acceptance ACK.
claude-sdk.quality_boundary: SDK results and process facts do not establish a sealed candidate, independent tests, human acceptance or deployment health.
claude-sdk.errors.changed: Claude SDK configuration changed; prepare a new dispatch preview
claude-sdk.errors.unavailable: The fixed Claude SDK configuration is not in the current authorized worker inventory
claude-sdk.errors.budget: Claude SDK supports observed usage only; enforced budgets are unavailable
